item.title: sublime text 2 설정파일
item.description:
// Settings in here override those in “Default/Preferences.sublime-settings”, and
// are overridden in turn by file type specific settings.
{
“font_face”: “나눔고딕코딩”,
“font_size”: 12,
“rulers”: [80, 120],
“tab_size”: 4,
“translate_tabs_to_spaces”: true,
“highlight_line”: true,
“line_padding_top”: 2,
“line_padding_bottom”: 2,
“default_encoding”: “UTF-8”,
“fallback_encoding”: “Korean (CP949)”,
“highlight_modified_tabs” : true
}

item.title: Sublime Text 필요 설정
item.description:
나눔 고딕 코딩으로 폰트 설정하고, 사이즈는 14, 위아래 4px씩 패딩을 준다

{
“font_face”: “나눔고딕코딩”,
“font_size”: 14,
“line_padding_top”: 4,
“line_padding_bottom”: 4
}
